definitions.explanation: Describes something that happens many times or at short intervals. More formal than よく and emphasizes the high frequency or repetition.

examples.japanese: {地震|じしん}が{頻繁|ひんぱん}に{起|お}きる。
{最近|さいきん}、{頻繁|ひんぱん}に{頭痛|ずつう}がする。
examples.english: Lately I've been getting headaches frequently.

examples.japanese: この{交差点|こうさてん}では{事故|じこ}が{頻繁|ひんぱん}に{発生|はっせい}しているので{信号機|しんごうき}が{設置|せっち}された。
examples.english: Accidents were occurring so frequently at this intersection that a traffic light was installed.

notes:
USAGE:
{頻繁|ひんぱん}に is more formal and emphatic than よく (often). It stresses the high frequency or closeness of intervals, and is common in news, reports, and formal writing.

COMMON PATTERNS:
{頻繁|ひんぱん} is a na-adjective that can also be used predicatively: {連絡|れんらく}が{頻繁|ひんぱん}だ (Contact is frequent). The adverbial form {頻繁|ひんぱん}に is more commonly used.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- よく — general "often," neutral register
- {頻繁|ひんぱん}に — emphasizes high frequency, somewhat formal
- しょっちゅう — "all the time," informal, sometimes implies annoyance
- しばしば — "often," literary/written style
